name: Refractive Index Tomography using Neural Fields
aliases: Refractive Index Tomography using Neural Fields (RNTF)
definition: A method to recover a 3D refractive index field (eta) and luminance field from single-view refracted image measurements by optimizing neural fields that represent these quantities.
summary: Refractive Index Tomography using Neural Fields recovers 3D refractive index and luminance from single views by modeling physical light propagation via ODEs, unlike standard NeRF methods.
